versions.author: Boris Delange
versions.message: Add the RxNorm Extension ingredient Heparin Sodium (35884360) with its descendants. RxNorm Extension carries it as a standard Ingredient separate from the RxNorm ingredient heparin (1367571), so its 177 descendants, mostly European products (e.g. Novo-Heparin, Hepaflush), were not reached by the heparin anchor and a site mapping its heparin products to them was counted as not covered. Low molecular weight heparins (RxNorm Extension 35884361, 35884372) stay out of this set, which covers unfractionated heparin.
